p: Two short lists below: questions about the school, and the technical notes the pool-violation notice links to. Placeholder text for now — real answers will follow.
Do I need experience to start? No — there are classes for first-timers and for returning dancers.
How do I enrol? Reach out through the Contact page and we will place you in a suitable class.
What should I wear? Comfortable clothing you can move in; specific shoe notes come with each class.
Do you offer trial classes? Yes — ask about a first visit before you commit.
Why did a notice appear? The data asked for an element that is not in the shared component pool, so it was not rendered — the notice surfaces that instead of dropping it silently.

What is the component pool? A curated allow-list of element prototypes (the shared pool.html) that the front-end will clone. If a tag is neither already on the page nor in the pool, nothing is created — a deliberate guard, not a bug.

How do I add an element to the pool? Add its prototype to the shared pool.html, then reference it from your JSON by its tag name; the injector clones one per array item (arrays materialize elements; strings set text).
Where do error details go? Here, in this technical list — the pool-violation notice links to this section.
